labs.title: Beacon Frame Analysis
labs.description: Extract SSID, BSSID, channel, security from beacon-only.pcapng

labs.title: Config Audit — WPS & PMF
labs.description: PLANNED — no hostapd configuration artifact or answer-validated activity is currently bundled; excluded from progress and XP.

labs.title: Wireless Recon — Hidden SSID & PNL
labs.description: Map 6 BSSIDs, a hidden SSID, client probes and association evidence from recon-lab.pcapng

labs.title: Traffic Analysis — Association Flow
labs.description: Synthetic 21-frame flow: association, EAPOL M1–M4 and example DHCP/ARP/ICMP/DNS/HTTP payloads; inspect the manifest limits

labs.title: WPA2 Handshake Identification
labs.description: Identify M1-M4, ANonce, SNonce, MIC, completeness

labs.title: PMKID Extraction — Reduced Handshake
labs.description: Extract PMKID from EAPOL M1 key data

labs.title: WPS Enumeration — PIN Risk Indicators
labs.description: Read WPS IE attributes and setup-lock state in the supplied frames; no full WPS PIN/M1–M8 exchange is included

labs.title: WPA3 Transition — Downgrade Risk
labs.description: Read PSK+SAE AKMs and MFPC-only in the fixture; a PSK handshake is present, but this alone does not prove an induced downgrade

labs.title: WPA3-Only Good Config
labs.description: Verify WPA3-only with PMF required — good config

labs.title: Deauth Frame Patterns — PMF States
labs.description: Classify captured deauthentication/disassociation frames, reason codes and SA Query; the capture alone does not prove receiver acceptance or impact

labs.title: Same-SSID Look-Alike — Infrastructure Analysis
labs.description: Compare look-alike BSSID/IEs and the captured client handshake; confirm ownership against an authorized inventory before calling it rogue

labs.title: Portal Traffic & Client-Isolation Analysis
labs.description: Open network with simulated DHCP/HTTP and a two-station ARP exchange; separate what the fixture shows from portal/session claims

labs.title: Enterprise Recon & Config Audit
labs.description: Inspect synthetic 802.1X/EAPOL framing and the documented illustrative profile; TLS records/MSK are structural/example data, not a certificate-validation test

labs.title: EAP PEAP-MSCHAPv2 Analysis
labs.description: Compare EAP outer-method identifiers and the separate direct MS-CHAPv2 fixture material; no complete PEAP TLS tunnel or client certificate-validation outcome is captured

labs.title: RADIUS Authenticators & Attributes
labs.description: Inspect RADIUS packet fields/authenticators and VLAN attribute in the fixture; it does not reveal or prove a deployed shared secret, NAS configuration, or policy outcome

labs.title: Corporate Sequence — Evidence & Limits
labs.description: Management frames, a look-alike BSS, lab EAP-MSCHAPv2 packets and a synthetic ICMP pair; inspect limits (no DHCP/PEAP/RADIUS evidence)

labs.title: Methodology Capture Review — Self-Assessment
labs.description: Eight BSSIDs including a weak-PSK exercise target and look-alike; inspect beacon/probe, WPS and handshake evidence. Synthetic EAP/ICMP frames do not prove production certificate validation or segmentation policy

labs.title: Final Wireless PT Assessment
labs.description: Independent synthetic Case C-20 baseline and staged capstone-retest.pcapng; compare advertised policy, confirm inventory and mark real client retest NOT TESTED (self-review only)

labs.title: WEP Config Audit
labs.description: Identify obsolete WEP and explain IV/RC4 weaknesses; determine severity from exposure and impact rather than labeling it Critical by default

labs.title: RSN IE Analysis
labs.description: Inspect the fixture RSNE for advertised AKM, cipher and PMF capability; distinguish advertised policy from negotiated/enforced behavior
